rpcs.name: ensure_unit_inventory_mapping
rpcs.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_unit_inventory_mapping()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ begin if not exists (select 1 from public.unit_resource_requirements u where u.unit_id = new.unit_id) then raise exception 'Unit has no configured inventory resources'; end if; return new; end $function$

rpcs.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_photo_access(object_name text, write_access boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select object_name ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.webp$'
  and exists (
    select 1 from public.properties p join public.company_members cm on cm.company_id=p.company_id
    where p.company_id::text=split_part(object_name,'/',1)
      and p.id::text=split_part(object_name,'/',2)
      and cm.user_id=(select auth.uid())
      and (not write_access or cm.member_role in ('owner','admin','manager'))
  );
$function$

rpcs.name: public_calendar_blocks
rpcs.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_calendar_blocks(p_property_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(starts_on date, ends_on date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select b.starts_on,b.ends_on from public.unit_blocks b join public.physical_units u on u.id=b.unit_id join public.properties p on p.id=u.property_id where p.id=p_property_id and p.published=true and u.active=true $function$

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER reservations_require_inventory BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF unit_id ON public.reservations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ensure_unit_inventory_mapping()

CREATE TRIGGER sync_reservation_inventory_trigger AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF unit_id, checkin, checkout, status ON public.reservations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_reservation_inventory()
CREATE TRIGGER sync_unit_block_inventory_trigger AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF unit_id, starts_on, ends_on ON public.unit_blocks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_unit_block_inventory()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_inventory_mapping_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.unit_resource_requirements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_inventory_mapping_changes()
CREATE TRIGGER owner_property_revision BEFORE UPDATE ON public.properties FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION owner_property_revision()

constraints.name: prevent_unit_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (unit_id WITH =, daterange(checkin, checkout, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text])))

constraints.name: reservations_unit_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES physical_units(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: unit_blocks_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (unit_id WITH =, daterange(starts_on, ends_on, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: inventory_allocations_resource_id_tstzrange_excl
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (resource_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.name: allocation_source_consistency
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((allocation_kind = 'reservation'::text) AND (reservation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (block_id IS NULL)) OR ((allocation_kind = 'block'::text) AND (block_id IS NOT NULL) AND (reservation_id IS NULL)) OR ((allocation_kind = 'hold'::text) AND (reservation_id IS NULL) AND (block_id IS NULL))))
